gather.name: Raw Material
gather.effect: Select an empty space.\n\nIf you have a second "Raw Material" card, discard both and build a wall or a bridge there.

gather.name: Ivory and Violet
gather.effect: Discard as many Pikmin on one space as you'd like.\n\nGet 1 Purple for every 5 Pikmin discarded this way, or 1 White for every 2.

gather.name: Phosbat Pod
gather.effect: Select an empty enemy space.\n\nSpawn an enemy there.

gather.name: Bomb Rock
gather.effect: Discard all Pikmin on one space (excluding HOME).\n\nIf that space has health, do 10 damage to it.

gather.name: Captain Clone
gather.effect: This card has the same effect as the card currently on top of the gather discard pile.

gather.name: Color Changing Posy
gather.effect: Play as a pellet.\n\nExchange for 5 of one of the starting Pikmin colors.

gather.name: Ultra-Spicy Spray
gather.effect: Apply to a Space.\n\nAll friendly Pikmin on this space act twice this turn.

gather.name: Warp
gather.effect: Swap the position of two bosses on the map, or move an enemy to any empty enemy space

gather.name: Candypop Bud
gather.effect: Choose a space and a color (Red, Blue, or Yellow).\n\nAll friendly Pikmin on that space become that color.

gather.name: Oatchi Rush
gather.effect: Pick a lane.\n\nIf that lane is clear, and the treasure is not on your side, move it towards you two spaces.

gather.name: Rock Storm
gather.effect: Select an empty space that doesn't have a hazard.\n\nCreate an available hazard there.

gather.name: Survey Drone
gather.effect: Shuffle one treasure pile.

gather.name: Pikmin Extinction
gather.effect: All Pikmin on all spaces (Including HOME) are discarded.\n\nEach player gets 1 of each starting Pikmin color at their HOME.

gather.name: Candypop Bud
gather.effect: Choose a space and a color (Rock, Winged, or Ice).\n\nAll friendly Pikmin on that space become that color.

gather.name: Boulder
gather.effect: Discard all Pikmin on one space (excluding HOME).\n\nIf that space has health, do 5 damage to it.

gather.name: Ultra-Bitter Spray
gather.effect: Apply to a space.\n\nEnemies on this space skip their next action.

gather.name: Ship Signal
gather.effect: Select one treasure pile.\n\nRearrange the contents of that pile in any way you want.

gather.name: Queen Candypop Bud
gather.effect: Choose a space and one of the three starting Pikmin colors.\n\nAll friendly Pikmin on that space become that color.

gather.name: Pikpik Carrot Bundle
gather.effect: Place on an enemy space.\n\nThis takes damage before your pikmin do. It has 5 health.

gather.name: Mine
gather.effect: Once this space takes 10 damage, it will discard all Pikmin that end on it.\n\nIt takes one damage every time a Pikmin passes it.

gather.name: Ice Bomb
gather.effect: Apply to a space.\n\nAll Pikmin and enemies on this space do not act on their next turn.

gather.name: Lightning Storm
gather.effect: Apply to a 2 by 2 area of 4 spaces.\n\nAll Pikmin and enemies on these spaces do not act on their next turn.
